exposure: history of preeclampsia during a prior pregnancy
cohort: Mothers with and without hypertensive disorders who delivered between 7/1/2016-12/31/2018 and their infants
finding: Mothers with preeclampsia or superimposed preeclampsia experienced more adverse neonatal and maternal outcomes compared to those without hypertension, while outcomes for mothers with gestational hypertension were similar to those without hypertension.
